verdict.rationale: Zulip has no llms.txt (404) and no discoverable OpenAPI/docs-in-markdown at expected agent-friendly endpoints (404s for /api/.md, /openapi.json, /swagger.json). However, a full machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec does exist in the GitHub repo and the REST API/CLI can be driven headlessly, giving agents an indirect path to structured docs even though no explicit agent-oriented entry point is provided.
